import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    """
    Router component that directs claims to three output ports based on ordered rules.
    Rules are evaluated in order; a row goes to the FIRST matching port only.
    Unmatched rows go to the default port (standard).
    """
    claims = inputs['claims'].copy()
    
    # Initialize output dataframes
    claims_fast_track = pd.DataFrame(columns=['claim_id', 'amount', 'photos_attached'])
    claims_high_value = pd.DataFrame(columns=['claim_id', 'amount', 'photos_attached'])
    claims_manual_review = pd.DataFrame(columns=['claim_id', 'amount', 'photos_attached'])
    claims_standard = pd.DataFrame(columns=['claim_id', 'amount', 'photos_attached'])
    
    # Track which rows have been matched
    matched = pd.Series(False, index=claims.index)
    
    # Rule 1: amount <= 500 and photos_attached == 1 → fast_track
    mask1 = (claims['amount'] <= 500) & (claims['photos_attached'] == 1)
    rule1_rows = claims[mask1 & ~matched]
    if len(rule1_rows) > 0:
        claims_fast_track = pd.concat([claims_fast_track, rule1_rows[['claim_id', 'amount', 'photos_attached']]], ignore_index=True)
        matched = matched | mask1
    
    # Rule 2: amount > 10000 → high_value
    mask2 = claims['amount'] > 10000
    rule2_rows = claims[mask2 & ~matched]
    if len(rule2_rows) > 0:
        claims_high_value = pd.concat([claims_high_value, rule2_rows[['claim_id', 'amount', 'photos_attached']]], ignore_index=True)
        matched = matched | mask2
    
    # Rule 3: photos_attached == 0 or amount > 500 → manual_review
    mask3 = (claims['photos_attached'] == 0) | (claims['amount'] > 500)
    rule3_rows = claims[mask3 & ~matched]
    if len(rule3_rows) > 0:
        claims_manual_review = pd.concat([claims_manual_review, rule3_rows[['claim_id', 'amount', 'photos_attached']]], ignore_index=True)
        matched = matched | mask3
    
    # Unmatched rows go to default port (standard)
    unmatched_rows = claims[~matched]
    if len(unmatched_rows) > 0:
        claims_standard = pd.concat([claims_standard, unmatched_rows[['claim_id', 'amount', 'photos_attached']]], ignore_index=True)
    
    return {
        'claims_fast_track': claims_fast_track,
        'claims_high_value': claims_high_value,
        'claims_manual_review': claims_manual_review
    }
